clue.text: A shaman got April confused about imaginary figures

definitions.note: an adjective: relating to a shifting series of phantoms

indicators.note: confused tells us the letters of the preceding words are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A shaman muddles the month of April while talking about imaginary figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' rearranges all fifteen letters of A SHAMAN GOT APRIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A phantasmagoria is a sequence of dreamlike illusory figures, so the adjective means concerning such imagined apparitions.

clue.text: Resistance is overcome by changing shapes and expressions

indicators.note: the resistance letter is covered over, enclosed by the rearranged word that follows

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: An electrical image: resistance overwhelmed by shifting forms and expressions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' turns SHAPES into PHASES; 'is overcome by' sets R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrases are groups of words, i.e. ways of putting things or expressions.

a scribe is one who writes, a copyist or author

explanation.definitionFit: To ascribe something is to attribute or credit it to someone, a synonym of assigning.

clue.text: Young child settled heretical belief in tyranny

explanation.surface: A small child grows up with a heretical faith under a tyrant.
explanation.definitionFit: Totalitarianism is absolute, oppressive state control, a modern form of tyranny.

clue.text: Meet under the main promenade

to front is to face or confront, i.e. meet head on

explanation.surface: Arranging to meet someone beneath the ocean, like a mermaid's date.
explanation.definitionFit: A seafront is the stretch of town along the shore, typically lined by a promenade walkway.

clue.text: Walk a line, lacking directions for chemical base

indicators.note: lacking tells us some letters are missing from the phrase before

parts.note: W, N and E are the compass directions west, north and east; the answer's letters also run through the phrase, but that is a coincidence of the deletion, not a hiding

explanation.surface: A sobriety test, walking a straight line, oddly ending in a chemistry term.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove W, N and E from WALKALINE, leaving ALKALI.
explanation.definitionFit: An alkali is a soluble base in chemistry, the opposite of an acid.

clue.text: Finished the map off, losing time measuring and marking too much

parts.note: over means finished or ended

indicators.note: off signals the remaining letters are out of order
losing means a letter is dropped from the words before

parts.note: sizing means measuring for size

explanation.surface: Someone completes a map but overdoes the marking, losing track of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops T from THE MAP, leaving HEMAP; 'off' rearranges it to EMPHA.
explanation.definitionFit: To overemphasize is to stress or highlight something excessively, like underlining it too heavily.

clue.text: Pay Republican immigrant

explanation.definitionFit: An incomer is someone who has newly moved into an area or country, a newcomer.

clue.text: People mark course

a track is a mark or trail left behind

clue.text: Do better without prison space, mostly

clue.text: Spin is turning over wicket on both sides

turning means the word is is read backwards

clue.text: Comfort before PM cut parliament's opening: it shows highs and lows

parts.note: relief means comfort or ease

clue.text: Reprieved area moves west in extent

clue.text: New and old kit in Alabama

clue.text: Cut into victim

clue.text: Perhaps make a crocodile tail rise

clue.text: Cockney actor in favour of being heard acts at first in jug

indicators.note: Cockney speech drops the initial h, so the word loses its first letter

indicators.note: at first means take the first letter of the word

explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney drops H, so HAM becomes AM; FOR is spoken and written PHOR; A from acts.
explanation.definitionFit: An amphora is a tall two-handled ancient Greek or Roman jar, a kind of jug.

clue.text: Most of group adulterated mare's milk substitutes

clue.text: European and Gaelic hybrid is mournful

clue.text: Influential discussion group with U-turn at the end?

clue.text: Initially nonchalant, I'm thrown rather in calculation of N

clue.text: Making up for leaving father split inside

the second letter of pa, the informal word for father, goes in separately

explanation.walkthrough: PA is parted around the first I of EXITING: EX-P-I-A-TING.

clue.text: Reportedly cultivate a green when dropping head of drug science
